# KG-SSOT

> Verifiable knowledge graphs in plain text (`.kg.yaml` to write, or the same model in `.kg.json` for runtime use): a confirmed or production claim must carry its source, and can carry the date it was last verified and what it was verified against; a formal contract (JSON Schema, MUST and SHOULD levels) decides in CI whether the file is well formed. Release 4.22.0, contract v4, license Apache-2.0. The reference reader is Python 3.11 or later and runs without any agent harness.

For an agent that will write or validate a `.kg.yaml`: read the format (chapter 3) and the contract (chapter 4); validate with `python3 -I -B vendor/kg-ssot/tools/kg_validate.py <file>` (in a clone of the repository, `tools/kg_validate.py`; from the PyPI package, `kg-validate <file>`) and fix by the codes in chapter 9. The schemas rule: when the manual and a schema disagree, the schema wins. Use `--format json` for a machine-readable verdict and decide by `code`: codes, keys and exit codes never change with the output language, while the `message` and `hint` text follows it. The whole text, in one file, is in [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

- [Adopting](ADOPTING.md): bring the release into a repository, pin the version and run the gate in CI

## Write a graph

- [Concepts](docs/manual/02-concepts.md): node, types, status, planes, edges, provenance, verification stamp
- [Format](docs/manual/03-format.md): every field of `.kg.yaml`, taken from the schema
- [Contract](docs/manual/04-contract.md): MUST vs SHOULD, error codes, versions
- [Troubleshooting](docs/manual/09-troubleshooting.md): what each error code means and how to fix it
- [Recipes](docs/manual/08-recipes.md): common tasks, step by step

## Tools and integration

- [Tools](docs/manual/05-tools.md): `kg_validate`, `kg_conformance`, `kg_gate`, `kg_vendor`, `kg_store`, `kg_query`, `kg_diff`, `kg_vocab` (the domain vocabulary, with exports to SKOS-XL and Apache Ossie), `kg_criterion` (the pre-registered criterion), `kg_audit` (the audit package by question), `kg_mcp` (the reference MCP server), `kg_migrate`, `kg_prov_export`
- [Adoption and CI](docs/manual/06-adoption-and-ci.md): the short path to bring the contract into a repository, and how to use it in an app

## Contract (the sources of truth)

- [MUST](spec/kg-contract-v4.schema.json): what fails
- [SHOULD](spec/kg-contract-v4.should.schema.json): what only warns
- [Verdict](spec/verdict.schema.json): the shape of the JSON verdict (`kg-ssot.verdict/1`)
- [Release](spec/release.json): the version, the tag and the list of files that ship
